name: bait-concurrent-mark-read
description: Bait control, a frontend variant of the second-actor pattern. markRead follows dismiss line for line: call the API, show an error toast on failure, reload the list either way. The temptation: the notification was dismissed in another tab, the server answers not found, and the user sees an error toast for a notification that is gone. That needs a second actor and a server reply no shown code proves; the error is handled and the reload shows the current list. Nothing to report.
